_comment: Session-level analysis prompts (DATA, not code) — #65 Phase 1.
Each kind is one whole-transcript prompt; the judge returns a JSON
object the Studio renders verbatim. Placeholders: {facts} {transcript}.
Literal braces in the templates are doubled because str.format fills
them. required_keys is what the parser insists on; everything else is
coerced or dropped. Bump version when a template changes so stored
